observations.observation: Read all3610 characters. Preprocessing classifies five species before a task-by-task GIID construction and application. Vigor, stability and evenness are separately operationalized, giving nonmonotonic biomass against increasing stability/evenness; two species suffice in this study, unlike other recent papers' different thresholds. Optimal-moisture differences must be moderate, with both extremes failing to benefit the community. Drought frequency changes whether added species increase or decrease biomass, while the stated stability benefit remains. Habitat and pollution reduce capacity/biomass without erasing multispecies stability. The ending openly says all three varied factors are sensitive and turns to appraisal/improvement; do not rewrite this as a robustness success. Figure references are only author narrative, not reviewed images. Form/banner and discretionary word wraps need individual checking; source completeness remains unaccepted.
